title: One genome yielding diverse forms in different environments could shape evolution

fields.label: Label
fields.value: One genome yielding diverse forms in different environments could shape evolution

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The additional morphogenetic competencies revealed by Anthrobots could matter for evolutionary developmental biology, since the evolution of anatomical and functional features could be affected by the ability of the same genome to produce very diverse forms in different environments.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Conclusion

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: More fundamentally, these data reveal additional morphogenetic competencies of cells which could have implications for evolutionary developmental biology, as evolution of anatomical and functional features could be affected by the ability of the same genome to produce very diverse forms in different environments.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Conclusion”. Scope: Evolution of anatomy in multicellular organisms

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-29: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.45

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Existing data demonstrate a narrow environmental reaction norm and can inform evolutionary simulations. They cannot resolve the broad historical implication or its magnitude.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Across genotypes and environments, estimate reaction norms for morphology and function and test evolutionary models in which environment-dependent form changes accessible phenotypic variation and selection responses.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Engineered culture plasticity does not establish historical evolutionary influence.

The statement says evolution could be affected without a quantitative effect prediction.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.46
data adequacy: 0.28
data existence: 0.58
discriminating power: 0.38
analysis feasibility: 0.55

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The culture result shows one genome supporting more than one multicellular form. The evolutionary sentence only says that this capacity could matter for how anatomy evolves. No existing comparative or fossil analysis has a defined outcome that would establish or rule out that possibility.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: That one human genome yields both airway epithelium and an Anthrobot anatomy in two environments can be granted from the culture result. 'Could affect the evolution of anatomical features' names no phylogenetic pattern, rate or fossil contrast that would confirm or refute an evolutionary effect.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
A modal claim that evolution could be affected is compatible with every phylogenetic outcome.

Environmental disclosure of epithelial mechanics does not, by itself, show a change in what selection sees.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.1
data adequacy: 0.12
data existence: 0.2
operationalizability: 0.24
analysis feasibility: 0.22
